generator_metadata.summary: Place one compact one-to-three-color motif strictly inside a 0-background grid. The output is the smallest rectangular crop containing every non-zero cell. Size, palette, color count, density, and interior position are independently controlled and observable.

## `297c05190f7c`

The teaching bank alternates merge-wins and single-wins scenes, preventing source-size, source-bbox, per-color-total, always-merged, alternate-setting, and smallest-component shortcuts. Its wrong-order protected-Racket witness ranks original components before filling and changes 44 cells.

Retained evidence includes `checks/297c05190f7c/audit.json`, `checks/297c05190f7c/qualification/qualification.json`, `checks/297c05190f7c/causal/witness.json`, and the public projection checks. The direct combined raw-pytest attempt hit the inherited staged `scripts.canonical_profile_gate` import assumption; the supported packet `task-tests` launcher passed all 39 inherited tests, and the independent family suite passed all five tests.

## `26cfe7595a4a`

The inherited generator declared controls that were dead or aliased and lacked strict rule/shape validation. The repair makes each declared axis observable, rejects unknown or wrongly typed overrides, supports 6..30 grids, and fails closed on malformed, blank, border-touching, or non-ARC grids. previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (h~6-10, w~7-11) with ONE COMPACT MULTICOLOR MOTIF placed in the interior (rows 1..h-mh-1, cols 1..w-mw-1) where mh, mw ∈ 2..4. Motif is filled at 70% density with 3 DISTINCT colors arranged in a checker (color[(r+c) % 3]). Bbox corners of the motif are guaranteed non-zero so bbox is well-defined. Surrounding bg padding ≥1 cell on all sides. Rule (TIGHT BBOX CROP): identify all non-0 cells. COMPUTE their BBOX. CROP the grid to that BBOX. EMIT the cropped subgrid. Net: surrounding bg padding is removed; output is the tight motif crop.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The cropped grid together with the nonzero color counts on its newly created perimeter.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Crop the input to the tight bounding box containing every nonzero cell, thereby creating a new top, bottom, left, and right perimeter.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Select the unique most frequent nonzero color on that new perimeter and recolor every occurrence of that color in the crop to 8.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Perimeter membership is defined only after the crop. The crop-wide/global mode can differ from the new perimeter mode, so replacing the Step-A perimeter census with a global census changes the protected-Racket output on this qualified case.

parametric_work.summary: `border_rule=crop_only` is byte-exact canonical; `highlight_perimeter_mode` consumes the new crop perimeter and recolors its unique nonzero mode. Two demos uniquely identify each setting against the declared bounded rival library.

target_report.summary: Repaired dead/aliased controls and fail-open validation, then added a crop-created-perimeter selector family with matched inputs, constructive teaching, protected-Racket audit, qualification, causal replay, and private-query-safe public projections.
